result.explanation: The conditional rule is: accept a reservation exactly when its ID is unused, its interval and units are valid, and adding its units never exceeds capacity at any integer instant in the half-open interval. Otherwise preserve state and reject. Cancellation removes only an active ID.
result.mapping: State maps each active ID to {start,end,units}; output maps the active records to sorted IDs and sums their units. Interval feasibility is checked pointwise for t=start through end-1, which is equivalent for integer endpoints and half-open intervals.
result.assumptions: Identifiers are compared by exact string equality and sorted lexicographically. The supplied config is authoritative on every call; state is only the returned reservation collection.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let s=null;for(let i=0;i<output.length;i++){let z=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});if(JSON.stringify(z.output)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false;s=z.state}return true}
